svg.text: COMMERCE FLOW: ORDER MANAGEMENT > INVENTORY > PAYMENT (saga over Kafka)
Numbered steps = happy path. Every message is at-least-once, so every consumer is idempotent. Scenarios below show what happens when a step fails.
SCENARIOS: what happens when a step fails
A Out of stock (fails at step 4)
• Inventory: qty < n, atomic update rejects
• Notify user. Nothing to undo, no payment taken
• Void the authorization (cheap, no refund fee)
D User never pays / reservation expires
• Reaper job restocks (Mongo TTL only deletes
• the doc, it does NOT return stock)
• Order Mgmt restarts, reloads saga state
G PSP webhook late or missing
• then DLQ + alert, saga flagged stuck
